A generic wooden staff used for various crafting and construction purposes. Staves are made from slender tree trunks by delimbing and debarking the trunk and cutting it to desired length. A common staff is about two meters in length with a diameter that fits nicely in one's hand.
For making staves efficiently only the suitably thick parts of the slender trunks are preferred. Some thinning down and smoothing of the surface is almost always needed, but the finished staves are foremostly rough raw material. When utilized further in crafting they are then worked on more carefully as needed.

g389_doc_f1d6d1fa323b3ca5a48a.text:
Spruce quick-bow is the most simple and quick to make type of a bow. It's made out of a single branch that is cut from a standing spruce tree. After the small side branches are cut away and the quick-bow is practically ready to be strung, although sometimes quick tillering is needed. It goes without saying that this type of bow is not a high performance weapon, but it is efficient enough for hunting squirrels and other small game.
Northern peoples sometimes go hunting small game carrying only arrows and a bowstring with them and then craft a spruce quick-bow only if need be.

g389_doc_f2374bb1fb58e8e60c9d.text: The glutton's length is about 75 cm and weight about 20 kg. Its fur is darkbrown. Gluttons keep far away from settlements. They live alone, even males and females have their own hunting grounds. Glutton hunts reindeers, hares, foxes, birds, frogs and mice. It also eats eggs and carrion.

g389_doc_f360920913e5be0da743.text: A kota is similar to a large tent. All cultures know how to construct and use  them, but they are most common among the northern people. The framework of a  kota consists of several interlocking slender tree trunks. After that, they  are covered by animal leather or fur to protect from rain and wind. The cover  is then secured with more slender tree trunks. Reindeer leather is most common,  but other large animals' pelt can also be used. In the cold of winter, a kota  must be covered with fur to be warm enough to sleep in.  Kotas vary in size and are usually cone shaped. Larger kotas are used as  dwellings, and can house a single person or even a family. Smaller ones can be  used for a number of purposes, like storing goods or cooking. A fireplace is  kept in the middle, with a hole in the center of the top of the kota for the  smoke to escape. The back of the kota (opposite of the entrance) is considered  sacred.

g389_doc_f38f29a0fd1b623b849d.text: A piece of armour that covers the skull. A typical helm is made from one piece of iron hammered into shape.

g389_doc_f4c976aa881b7dda8d14.text: A tendon is a fibrous connective tissue that attaches muscle to bone. Tendons of butchered animals are used in  making of sinew yarn.

g389_doc_f629b3ea9b88b33b4707.text:
A spindle is a tool made from wood used for spinning plant fibres into yarn.
All the fibre processing is carried out by using your TEXTILECRAFT skill.

g389_doc_f63d1dc8b9d1d3539047.text: Simply applying a cold compress to the wound. Necessary equipment/supplies: WATER and BANDAGES.

g389_doc_f7d2c705e5095bf03f93.text:
Koivulaiset (Those Who Live In The Koivula) are farmers. They have considerably large fields, cattle, sheep and horses. They have their homes near the lakes and rivers in the mid-west part of the UnReal World.
Twice a year they might spend couple of weeks in the wilderness, hunting, trapping and fishing, returning home with dried fish, smoked meat and furs. Otherwise they don't travel so much. They trade with the peddlers regularly visiting the Koivula. Their blacksmiths are known for their high quality items.

g389_doc_f7ea6d747a38eeb33376.text:
Sinew yarn is a strong, durable thread made from the fibrous tendons of animals. It is commonly used for sewing leather and fur, as well as for various crafting and binding tasks, such as attaching arrowheads. However, sinew yarn cannot be used for fishing tackle, as it weakens and stretches when wet.

To make sinew yarn, you first need animal tendons. These can be harvested from butchered animals of relatively large size. Leg tendons of large mammals, such as elk and reindeer, are preferred, but tendons from smaller animals can also be used, though they yield less useful sinew. Tendons are processed into sinew yarn using your TEXTILECRAFT skill through the following stages of work:

TENDON DRYING - First of all, fresh tendons need to be dried. They are spread out flat or hung in a dry, preferably warm place until stiff. This takes a day or two.

SEPARATE SINEW FIBRE - Next, the dried tendon is pounded with a club or similar tool on a hard surface until the sinew fibres begin to separate. The fluffy, thin fibres are then pulled apart and collected by hand into small bundles.

SINEW YARN - Finally, the obtained sinew fibres can be twisted together to form sinew yarn. This is done entirely by hand, as a spindle cannot be used. The fibres are occasionally moistened in the mouth to make them easier to handle and join as the yarn is being made.

g389_doc_f808401d850af6b0b0dd.text: A laminated recurve bow made of two different types of wood, and covered with birch bark to protect it from the elements. The belly is made from special reaction wood of pine trees  which gets developed when the tree grows aslant. The back and recurved ears are made of birch.  The laminates are glued together with a glue made from perch skin. Different characteristics of the two wood types used gives the northern bow its outstanding  performance and these bows are the finest and and fastest ones used among the peoples of the UnReal World.

g389_doc_f9062ae64407b363d1ee.text:
Nets are tools for passive fishing. They are set and left in the water for a day or two, and then retrieved hopefully with some fish caught in it. A common net in the game is about 8 meters long and 2 meters deep with a 5 centimeter mesh. This is a size a lone fisher can easily handle.

Nets can be set either by using the fishing skill or by applying the net from the inventory. To retrieve a net you can simply pick it up.

Every time a net is set and retrieved it wears out a bit, and the bigger the catch, the more it can damage the net. How fast a net wears out depends greatly on your fishing skills. A talented fisher can handle the net so that it doesn't get tangled upon setting or retrieving, or unnecessarily damaged upon releasing the fish. A novice fisherman is prone to handle the net in a more clumsy fashion which results in more wear and tear.

Making a net is a laborious task and they were usually woven indoors during wintertime. Yarn is naturally required in substantial amounts, and some stronger cordage for the supporting structure, as well as the float and weight lines. The floats were usually made of birch-bark and rocks were used as weights. In the finest nets, the rock weights were wrapped in birch-bark pockets for a more durable construction.

g389_doc_f922849ab916bf91f546.text: The wolf is like a big, strong dog. Its length is typically over one meter and weight about 50 kg. Wolves live and hunt in packs, but a lone wolf can also be strong enough to kill an elk. Usually wolves eat elks, reindeers and hares. Wolves are very fast and sturdy runners. They avoid humans and it is not easy to see them.

g389_doc_fb8fdb7444f562cfa44b.text: Building is the ability to construct forms of shelters and housing. Durable wooden buildings are usually for  permanent occupation but this skill can also be used to construct other dwellings such as kotas, and more simple,  temporary shelters, as well as other structures like fences. Timbercraft is a secondary skill to building,  since the wood that trees provide will be used extensively in the construction process.

g389_doc_fc61554d4bf021405a59.text: The polecat's length is about 45 cm and weight about 1 kg. It is active in the night. It is hunted for its fur.

g389_doc_fc6c511687cfcb6eeb78.text:
Any large sword intented for two-handed use. Most battleswords have broad, straight blades 48-60" in length.
Battlesword is a foreign sword and not known by the local cultures. As an imported weapon they may be rarely found among the wealthiest western peoples.

g389_doc_fc95ea46965c9d74e325.text: A veil is a women's head covering made from a rectangular piece of cloth. The edges of the cloth are sewn to prevent fraying and are sometimes also decorated with ornamental patterns. The veil is worn by simply tying it or fastening it with a brooch.

g389_doc_fd0a4a6094a7090b31ad.text: A round pendant nearly two inches wide, picturing a sun symbol inside a decorated rim. This fine piece of jewelry is imported by the foreign traders. Northern and Eastern peoples like this pendant, as they believe the sun symbol is associated with fertility, health and good luck.

g389_doc_fde73497d426c453d9d4.text:
Yarn is made either by spinning plant fibres or twisting sinew fibres into long strands. It is commonly used for sewing clothes, but has many other uses too. For example in crafting of a loop snare or line of a fishing rod.
There is also wool yarn which can be used be to make nalbound clothes. For spinning yarn by yourself refer to your TEXTILECRAFT skill.

g389_doc_fdec517f5923bac5a0b4.text: Trident is a triple-pointed spear. Trident is commonly used in fishing. When used as a combat weapon it attacks no better (sometimes worse) than a spear, but its three prongs gives it a somewhat better defensive capacity.

g389_doc_fe6b5edb399ddf8e6644.text:
Bark of different trees is used as raw material in various crafts, and also as tanning materials in hideworking. Bark can be harvested from rowan, alder, pine and birch trees by using the TIMBERCRAFT skill.
Pine bark can be used in making of floats for fishing nets. It can be harvested in chunks all year round from big pine trees.
From the leaf trees the bark can't be harvested all year round, but the best season for this is early summer. The process gets more difficult and the yield decreases accordingly outside the proper bark harvesting period, and eventually it becomes completely impossible in the late autumn. Birch-bark has the most versatile uses of all the bark types.

q026_g_f26c545db7768a35d85b.text: I see you have an eye for herbs. I just might have use for your knowledge of herblore if you're interested.

q026_g_bf82e9da15a33934dd02.text: I really need to find someone to help me in restocking my herb stores.

q026_g_758e2a008403b9dab3d3.text: I certainly possess the knowledge and experience but old age doesn't come alone. See, I used to enjoy wandering the shores and groves in search of healing plants and enjoyed being a part of the changing seasons, but nowadays my eyes and knees have gotten too weak to wander far from home. Seeking out the herbs is still a pleasure for me, but unfortunately a time-consuming and painful one.

q026_g_a686abaf620401d25559.text: My store of healing herbs is growing low, but my duties around here leave me with too little time go out on my clumsy legs and gather everything I need. If you know the local herbs and have the time, perhaps you would like to help me out and go find a little something I'm short of?

q026_g_8984d9658a6a695a8ee2.text: I can offer you a dose that will cure anything that ails you. I only have a little bit left at this time of year, but if you help me I'll give you some for your trouble.

q026_g_70c5c1a2b89c78834b13.text: Wonderful, come back when you have the herbs I need.

q026_g_88d79d7b70b9d1884d26.text: How is it going with the herb picking?

q026_g_91ba56f2e7f3e084e2d0.text: Here, take this herbal blend. It's good for wounds and makes a healthy herbal beverage too. May we meet again in friendship.

q026_g_843e21bda0c7a7b7810f.text: All-round way to sacrifice something in order to please or thank the spirits and otherworldly beings in various occasions.

q026_g_fa78ae5b635eb72bb891.text: After the bear is brought down its skull eventually needs to be placed to hang in a big lone pine-tree. That completes the hunting and burial ceremony and assures proper circulation of the bear spirit.

q026_g_471ffffcc809ebe0c8df.text: Forest maids are attracted to come at nighttime campfires in remote forests of spruce and moss by lighting the fire with seven spruce twigs in there along with good pile of other firewood. Sleep on the moss by such fire and they may appear.

q026_g_9485934753a212f8a4b4.text: When deadfall trap is made for a bear you should then set the meat bait there completely naked. Then the bear gets in there nicely.

q026_g_32c69c173e7990ef7eeb.text: Turn around and kick a tree with your heel and the squirrel will then stay still in there, even if it would have been jumping around a lot earlier.

q026_g_236301fe227a615cee55.text: Have a capercaillie feather with you when chasing a lynx. The feather is then put on lynx tracks from where it first fled, on its very first escaping tracks. This will burden the lynx, making it more quickly fatigued.

q026_g_a5f89cc94bb556395c5b.text: To make a fox trap favourable leave it laying at doorstep of a building where womenfolk will get to walk over it.

q026_g_44692cd3bd6bf92dec00.text: Baiting a fox-trap at your hunting grounds should be done just around sunset.

q026_g_3a2874b8ed7f1809e170.text: Be it birds or hares you are after, the loop snares you are about to use are made favorable by leaving them in an ant nest for three nights, and only then picked up and set for a catch.

q026_g_7c3fb412ac8b6ed31146.text: Loop snares for hares shouldn't be set barehanded but you should always wear mittens, and preferably woollen mittens.

q026_g_0ad29c9186c62696cf84.text: Bear is a great hunter who always finds its prey, and hunters who carry bear teeth with them can come across hares and game birds as they please.

q026_g_fd98b5752a297a167bc3.text: Bear hunter's mittens shouldn't be made of whatever material. It is the dog fur mittens you should wear in order to have your weapons to be effective and cut the bear good.

q026_g_7631b43e75fcd03b4bb9.text: The aspen tree for a punt should be felled when it's raining. Carving a punt out of such a log makes it good and fortunate one.

q026_g_5ad3ad0c1611f0784166.text: The very first fish of the spring that you catch with a fishing rod in open water season should be thrown back into the water to please the spirit of the water and assure your future fishing luck.

q026_g_563a358352bb00b71428.text: When first fish of the spring are caught out at a lake in open water season, make a fish soup or boil them right after returning on shore. When it's cooked, go away from the pot so that the spirit of the water can have the first taste.

q026_g_29feb8b233e825346bd2.text: You get a good catch if you step in the punt backwards and launch it in the water backwards.

q026_g_7a3cb443d1753fec0f40.text: Let your sheep run over your net and it will then be a fortunate one.

q026_g_ff16a592e26a3b2f0cdf.text: When going rod fishing you should first throw the fishing rod into the water, and then you have a good fishing luck.

q026_g_08a1b813f3bea29669ae.text: To get to see spirits of the water you should go stand naked on a rock in the water at night. It must be a single rock or skerry, completely surrounded by water, and the water folk may gather around it at midnight.

q026_g_e7eed42245a1ffeaffe5.text: Bird thief will come confess if you take three feathers that have remained from the stolen bird and throw them into heated sauna stove after the fire has burnt out. You can also throw the feathers into remains of burnt-out fire which was made on base rock.

q026_g_2fd7b189970375ce83c9.text: Incantation to stop the wounds from bleeding.

q026_g_86635ccf011e0f3a68c9.text: The spirit of the forest can be met and addressed by sacrificing silver at an ant nest. You do it alone at night, and then wait for the spirit to arrive. Do not fear and he may speak and show himself to you before dawn.

q026_g_b512ecf0b8cc0c6978b4.text: The forest can be persuaded to not to hide its thingies when going hunting. It is done by carrying a bread with you which is dropped and left at a spruce on a hill or cliff, and then this specific incantation is cast.

q026_g_f5528485833a28f3ef62.text: Incantation to greet earth dwellers and underground creatures upon sleeping on the ground at unfamiliar terrain. Performed to assure good night sleep and to avoid being harmed by the possibly angered underground folk.

q026_g_41c860f7ddf0ec92720a.text: Cut twigs from a living spruce tree and set them burning on the most fresh tracks of the missing animal you can find.

q026_g_a76847edba9efaace0af.text: I'm begging you, please don't hunt that wolf. You don't understand what is really going on here.

q026_g_b897c5fcdb8343cf9a07.text: But it isn't a wolf at all! If you hunt it down you'll be murdering an innocent man. Please let me explain.

q026_g_e0ccaa8e7f80760afdb3.text: Some time ago an adventurer came to our village. The weather had been terrible for a while. The wild animals were coming closer to the settlements hunting for food so it was a dangerous time in the wilderness. The stranger came to us looking for a warm bed for the night and a chance to replenish his supplies.

q026_g_f70ae01bd2671dca1714.text: We met that evening by the light of the fireside, and to my eyes he was the most handsome man I had ever seen. He had a way about him that made the village men listen to his words. There was a look in his eye that drew all the womenfolk - young and old - to flutter and fawn about him.

q026_g_6910e67c6e4b2a4598cc.text: He invited me to sit next to him after the evening meal and we talked long into the evening. By the time night had fallen and it was time to go to bed the warmth of the hearth fire had kindled flames of affection between us... and so I shared my furs with him.

q026_g_fcbe1268997b1281f19a.text: Anyway I thought that he shared my feelings, but after he had rested and traded for fresh supplies he shouldered his pack and strolled off into the wilderness he came from. He promised to return to me soon, but said that he needed the solitude of the lonely forests from time to time.

q026_g_bfaf75bc75308390c7e8.text: I saw the wolf once at the edge of the forest and it looked at me with the eyes of the adventurer. Oh, he needs to be found and made a man again before it is too late. Can I put my hope in you?

q026_g_92f05d1715479d76df60.text: He remembers nothing but having fainted outside our village, and then coming back to his senses further in the woods while devouring a bread. Having lost his clothes and being surrounded by wolf tracks he figured what had happened. But he managed to return, I gave him some supplies and he's back in the woods to recover now. I'm about to follow him soon, but first let me reward you with something that only a woman like me can offer.

q026_g_d5f70cbefb001e3c9b61.text: See, my very clothes are loaded with force of womanhood, and it's the kind that repels and scares the bears. Here, take a strip of my garment, wear it on your loin and no bear shall willingly come at you.

q026_g_0c705ccc54ca2925d82e.text: Have you've been told about the wolf yet?

q026_g_6d6e890779f73d76e353.text: There's a lone, troublesome wolf around here and able men are needed to hunt it down. Wouldn't you want to go after it and get yourself a nice fur, huh?

q026_g_5ddfbf2cd353cee99486.text: There might be a troublesome wolf around here, but you womenfolk shouldn't interfere. I just wanted tell you it's best to leave this region, it's not safe around here.

q026_g_dd891ee4fa1f3a3cf77e.text: Down with the lone troublesome wolves.

q026_g_79e1fe18f11cce407761.text: And in this matter I'm the one to listen to around here.

q026_g_8dc238ca9b74c4d4aef2.text: I must warn you for there are robbers around our forests.

q026_g_5fb5b0da24f8b0ac5cf7.text: True forest robbers are nesting in our vicinity. There they lurk in the woods, sneaking around and robbing lone wanderers - at our lands!

q026_g_65e5d8c6bb8d25c964b3.text: Nobody wants to meet them, but nobody wants them around either.

q026_g_845aa2813b792a9c4d78.text: I've been waiting for someone brave to step forward and go chase them away.

q026_g_8ef00cc7ff8268677010.text: There is nothing much to offer except the products and possessions of our village. Provided that you get the robbers defeated for good, I will make sure that you will be given decent amount of whatever goods and supplies you want from here.

q026_g_db704f73ca7e82b3f608.text: I'm awaiting good news about the robber chase...

q026_g_cf48280e9ac9b923fa58.text: Now I'm eager to hear how it ended up there. I see you survived, but how about the robber band? Are they beaten and chased away now?

q026_g_5a508ee23fdfc24089e9.text: A hero needs a reward and you shall be given one.

q026_g_83facd45c4364ef3d8be.text: So you found them, but didn't manage to chase them away?

q026_g_c6ae81622fcfc691d0dc.text: Good! Let us go then. The road goes ever on and on...

q026_g_ed5c5b9f64ca2b908d05.text: You bet. I can't even think about walking as it hurts so much. I guess I'm stuck here for couple of weeks.

q026_g_c54151a344e52c7ea6ff.text: Well, I have no trouble talking and my wounds have already started to heal.

q026_g_d9d463824000d47ee7ef.text: The locals are good people. They tended my wounds and gave me a safe place to rest. They promised to give me food until I'm recovered.

q026_g_da48b18671c31bcd7231.text: Now is it because you don't think it's worth the trouble anymore? That the winged prey would disappear from your traps too, huh?

q026_g_8bec9164525361589c6c.text: The thing is that there's a creature more cunning than a fox around here that keeps stealing birds - at least from my traps. And he walks on two feet.

q026_g_a92ca35a04eef2400c4e.text: I kind of hoped that you could have helped me with this matter.

q026_g_fed25bb6f476eb02d556.text: I have been trapping birds quite successfully for a long time but lately I started to find my snares emptied. Consistently. Somebody keeps stealing my winged prey.

q026_g_0ecebd2436cd0d2a9e3c.text: I don't suspect anyone specifically, but I certainly want the thief to be revealed in a righteous manner. But if I go asking around I fear it might cause bad blood among the neighbourhood.

q026_g_e60da2e68e5f9c5516e3.text: Stealing somebody's catch is a serious offense and I don't want anybody to get needlessly hurt, nor falsely accused. And...should this thief know harmful witchcraft he might cast hardship on you from a distance.

q026_g_3f218536b0ae70e34327.text: There are spells for revealing bird thieves, you know. And old bird hunters around here must know some of those. But it is awkward for me to approach my fellow villagers in this matter, especially as I don't know who the thief might be.

q026_g_6860593a98d54db60414.text: I don't have wealth to offer, but I ask you to trust that I'll find a little something precious to give you if you help me and things work out.

q026_g_af1969c4d98474bbfa91.text: I guess the bird thief case isn't solved yet, or let me know if you've figured out something.

q026_g_d752be43ba2f9716fa7a.text: Have you performed the spell yet?

q026_g_9e2dbd80491ab3cb3ed5.text: I guess now we just have to wait for the results. Whoever the thief might be I'm under impression he should now come to me and confess. Maybe after few days we'll know who it was, so let's wait and talk again after a while.

q026_g_62027d1434c9dec10b43.text: I have met a few of both during my time, and I also know the means to deal with them both if need be.

q026_g_9b06fb25428aa1773bbf.text: I speak of it only with bird hunters. If you need to know then prove yourself worthy. Go hunt a bird, bring it to me and then we'll talk.

q026_g_a1ea7a876c031088d45d.text: Apparently the word has spread. Well, I have confessed it already and I can confess it again. But what's it to you anyway?

q026_g_faa3e22a8f478472494d.text: I guess somebody made a spell. I got burning hot, kept sweating all day long and could barely sleep at all. After few days of suffering I just had to go and confess, and after that my condition relieved.

q026_g_130bc2b4bb955fe39025.text: You! You made me burn! Get away from my sight!

q026_g_0e3e84c92d5d6c4609da.text: I can't accept your precious gift unless I can give you something in return. I have this little valuable which is now yours to keep.

q026_g_9b0dbb578c133e09dc73.text: Can you help me? The strangest thing happened, I got lost in the forest and can't seem to find my way anymore.

q026_g_fcadca35553331a6387b.text: Don't say that. I can't make it on my own. I fear I will eventually perish here if it happens again.

q026_g_f906940da04270d8c478.text: I was roaming a familiar trail, and then all of a sudden I couldn't recognize the terrain anymore. The forest got completely silent and I felt like I was walking in a thick fog. I ended up just circling around aimlessly for days. I'm not sure, but maybe I had gotten in the forest cover. Then it went away and the forest seemed familiar again, but I'm still so very disoriented.

q026_g_d6e3bad28a45fcf5e7c6.text: Would you be able to take me to the nearest village? To any village at all with decent folk where I could rest and clear my head. After how terribly lost I got I really need to travel in a company.

q026_g_eab8dff937f67cd7a93a.text: there were two sons in a dream

q026_g_3fa637164f8bcebf3ed7.text: I have to think about this

q026_g_a590806c5028c65f78e0.text: I was hoping to hear that

q026_g_49cbc59cabcf5b40075a.text: it's best to prepare the offerings

q026_g_ce700877a549b58007ea.text: I see you have done a good share of fishing during your days, so I reckoned it's time for somebody to share the lore about water folk with you. See, I would be glad to tell you the essentials about lake dwellers and spirits of the water. The things that you must learn eventually, if you are to get along well with the water folk.

q026_g_3c3f4b7fbfad0e386dfb.text: Each and every lake, even the smallest ponds, have a guardian spirit of their own dwelling in depths, ruling and watching over their waters. The force of the water is the most powerful kind, and spirits of the water are mighty and moody beings. Some are helpful, some are cranky, but all are to be respected. Be aware of that, and also that they can sometimes appear for us people if it comes to that.

q026_g_7df28a5dbd93f62358cc.text: On rare occasion the old lake dwellers may come to loyal fisherman's campfire with important matters to reveal, but normally it is us who need to seek an audience with spirits of the water. Learning to meet them is desirable, especially for those who live off the waters. Mmm. And I am here to advise you about how, where and when you might get to see the water folk yourself.

q026_g_20b57ca9e3d9dc90319c.text: Spirits of the water can appear in many forms. They may dress in reeds and grass, and their voice is always bright, like a woman's. The oldest and mightiest lake dwellers are bowed long-bearded gaffers. The younger ones often appear as graceful men with reddish skin, big brown eyes and long black hair. Oh, but I'm quite sure you will recognize the spirit of the water when you meet one.

q026_g_3fb6f6de6b4cbc1afa00.text: Upon meeting spirits of the water, however it happens, do nothing but wait and observe. They rarely say a word, but their appearance reveals how things are. If they look gentle, or wear decorative clothes, it means they are pleased with you and good fish catches shall be given. But if they look gloomy then it's misfortunes and hardships to be feared, or sacrifices best to be performed.

q026_g_29057858cd28f1fc8b18.text: Spells and means to address the water folk are numerous, but I have told you enough already. Now, it is for you to decide when and whether to apply this knowledge. However, I would be pleased to hear if you one day come to notice that you really are the kind to whom spirits of the water appear for.

q026_g_51aee5b2cd8eb094bc53.text: It is evident that you can find the trails and hunt the game, so the spirits of the forest surely have been fond of you at times. But the spirit of the forest is also a ruler you better know closely if you are to thrive in his realm. So, I reckoned it's time for somebody to tell you the essentials about these matters. I've watched you, and I consider you worthy of the lore.

q026_g_0e676e6bd6e69a1e4d17.text: There are many otherwordly beings in the woods, but the mightiest is the spirit of the forest who rules over the forest and its animal. Hunters therefore have to observe certain rules, make sacrifices, and appease the spirits whose realm they roam. Each forest has a ruler of its own, and everything we hunt is theirs. Means to gain their favour are numerous but best assured if the spirit of the forest is met in person.

q026_g_6c343d7bf375fb27f4c4.text: Rarely does the spirit of the forest appear spontaneously before one's eyes. Should that happen it is usually a display of great satisfaction, or fury. It has to be important matters for the spirit of the forest to address people. But there are means to summon the spirit of the forest for an audience - a way for a hunter to seek advice as well to maintain good terms with the forest. You might dare to learn and make use of these ways.

q026_g_644839dfeddaf394c994.text: The spirit of the forest appears in form of an old man with extremely long beard, which is grey like tree lichen. He is quite a sight, and quite often even dressed in lichen and moss. He may first appear tall as the forest itself, peeking over the tree tops, but then walk at you as a mere short old man. Despite of varying appearance spirits of the forest all wear one thing in common, their recognizable grey hat.

q026_g_95e70b5a2e441a805680.text: The custom is to let the spirit do the talking. Don't fear, let the spirit approach, and listen to how the forest feels about you. A pleased spirit examines you with gentle big brown eyes, but an upset one faces you with a gloomy expression. His appearance speaks for itself, and if he decides to speak the words may lash, advice or praise you. The favoured hunters may be told where the game roams, or made aware of other important matters.

q026_g_5e0e1ae8178245247a9f.text: An angered spirit of the forest may revenge with sickness or getting you lost. To stay on good terms make good use of the hunting spells, and rely on sacrifices to give back for what you have received. Spells and means to address the forest are numerous, but meeting the spirit proves how your alliance really holds. That is all. Now I only wish that one day, you can tell me that you really are the kind whom the spirit of the forest appeared for.

q026_g_78d40471f3c3a2f910b3.text: Hey, it appears that you have got the work done. Good, thank you. Now let's settle that reward of yours, shall we?

q026_g_eaa0606f0848aa794f57.text: You don't care to listen to an old man?

q026_g_3abcd5e9d7f576ac5d2e.text: We live the transition period now. Summer season is passing and the winter is coming. The spirits, the dead and the forest folk move about more actively and freely these days. As the nights grow darker also the forest maids are more keen to find their way at lone campfires.

q026_g_2745e856c5113b0a36d5.text: Forest maids are pretty and secretive otherworldly forest folk who may sometimes appear to favoured wanderers, especially these days. Pretty maids in pretty dresses, that's what they look like, and what they let be seen is a real delight in the night.

q026_g_6bc6a5532ccd7ec8aa85.text: They are playful creatures, keen of delighting lone woodsmen. Showing off and murmuring their secrets for those who they fancy. Some find them intimidating figures who surely can disturb good night's sleep, but the times I've enjoyed their company it's always been from good.

q026_g_abae2297941ad7c121b4.text: They are playful creatures and keen of delighting...well...lone woodsmen. I've also had a pleasure to enjoy company of a forest maid years and years ago. Ahem. But who knows if they might also appear and murmur to woman wanderers who they fancy, or want to favour.

q026_g_77b18505178179719d2b.text: I reckon the forest was pleased with me, as were the forest maids. Sometimes they told where the game was, sometimes shared the night and the fire with me. My days of appealing to forest maids are long gone, but oh how I long and enjoy to hear stories and sightings of them.

q026_g_34fccdeb9ed5b00fda9e.text: If they ever reward you with something it's usually to be found behind nearby trees or so. Whatever you may receive, keep it to yourself and never tell anyone how you got it. Otherwise it disappears or gets ruined.

q026_g_4ca8dbecd30ce3b7a39d.text: They dwell in distant forests of spruce and moss. This transition from summer to winter, the fall and dirt months, it is their time. Spend the night alone at spruce mire, sleeping on moss by the campfire, and you might meet them. That is, if they find you appealing, or you follow the means to attract them.

q026_g_bb8a60f046b97ea19af2.text: They can tease and seduce, but also to favour and reward. There are rumors of their most dearest being rewarded with clothes that never wear out, but I wouldn't know about that. Should you ever meet a forest maid my advise is to stay put, wait for her initiative and see where it goes.

q026_g_c3b9f9252d9c6e8cb27a.text: That is good to hear. For a moment I thought you have been informed by our common gossiper just like everybody else around here. She loves to talk on my behalf, but she is just all wrong.

q026_g_743f1cdff38e85511b5e.text: I truly met a forest maid last year while working in the woods. Sleeping under the open sky I woke up one night to a pretty maid standing next to my campfire, smiling at me. Then she came and snuggled beside me. I was mesmerized by her beauty, and soon fell asleep again.

q026_g_aa80236b685bf840e0be.text: When I woke up, the fire was out, and she stood in the distance asking me to follow. It was still dark, but I went, following her far from the campsite. Suddendly she turned and I saw the backside. It looked all hollow or barklike. I startled and she just disappeared among the trees.

q026_g_017e07081ffb11917eab.text: I was freezing and frightened and barely found back to the camp, only to notice that I couldn't remember where I had left my axe. So, unfortunately I had to return back to the village. That's it. Now if you too are about to laugh behind me back go ask my uncle about these things.

q026_g_2a0edc68aafadc0e41db.text: Oh, this miserable season... Woe is me...

q026_g_798756810eba65974adf.text: I've been fishing for as long as I can remember. But now my dear old punt is broken. Oh, woe and sorrow! It was such a good punt!

q026_g_8137d68471b7fcb8f860.text: Everytime I hear a Kuikka calling I want to be out at the lake, to paddle down to the places where I've spent so many golden moments. But it's all broken now, that trusty punt of mine.

q026_g_ea354dc99fffa6fc61c2.text: I happen to know some fishing tricks and spells that you too might appreciate. Give me a hand here and I'll teach you some for the trouble.

q026_g_bc5fb40694a9345b1277.text: You must know quite a bit about fishing already, but if you help me with the punt I'll teach you to improve those skills a bit more.

q026_g_c3ad742244b3fc669839.text: How is it with the punt?

q026_g_dd3a5a947223ebc18408.text: It's some fishing instructions for you then.

q026_g_1738585d526ff283ae64.text: You brought the log. Good. I'll start carving right away.

q026_g_99984dca7242ab8be1af.text: This was very helpful of you, <plr_identity>. Many thanks.

q026_g_b9a059156292cfa454c1.text: Oh how I long to see my beloved adventurer again - alive. <plr_identity>, I seek help from you...

q026_g_2422de888b07ae8d1927.text: Oh, <plr_identity>, I'm so relieved. My dear adventurer is alive and a man again! While you were away he returned to me and we met briefly outside the village away from people's eyes. He is quite well, the curse is broken and I believe you are to thank for that!

q026_g_08928988da43e47c6c79.text: I think you should leave now, <plr_identity>.

q026_g_79dec869ab255371242f.text: The road goes ever on and on, <plr_identity>, or what?

q026_g_45a26902c3062bbf3b22.text: Now may I ask you, <plr_identity>, have you tried trapping birds around here lately?

q026_g_9779640d09087d6b2367.text: We still have to wait, <plr_identity>. I have no news about the thief.

q026_g_3ceeb6c078af77054761.text: You know what, <plr_identity>, it did happen! The thief came to visit me and confessed it all. Whatever you did, it worked!

q026_g_6da3815349c1a77a0a39.text: You may have come to the right man. Speak up, <plr_identity>, what is it?

q026_g_2fef01a0b11b624bf7a3.text: Go ahead, <plr_identity> and prove to be a bird hunter.

q026_g_ac1425d5951e5fdbbf4e.text: Would you please just walk me to the village, <plr_identity>.

q026_g_e2f7d3da7383c65e601e.text: Thank you for bringing me here, <plr_identity>. This is where I'll stay. But before we part now let me reward your efforts.

q026_g_41f60e92fb213b8173ef.text: You know what, <plr_identity>, I've been thinking it is the time you should get to know the water folk.

q026_g_01b13e46d2154676a6f6.text: You can fish and you can row, but you need to be aware of those who rule and guard the fish and the waters. You lack certain knowledge about spirits of the water, <plr_identity>, and that is something I would like to put in order.

q026_g_d61ae7b2241fc9d2ddf5.text: Bear in mind, <plr_identity>, what I've told you about the water folk.

q026_g_a4c64af010ae2e17ab84.text: Tell me, <plr_identity>, how would you like to get to know those whose forests you roam?

q026_g_3e45e4f1eab3c6dd14d8.text: I believe you have been given a decent share of preys during your hunting times, but I doubt if you are properly aware of those who rule and guard the forests and the animals. You seemingly haven't gotten to know the spirit of the forest yet, <plr_identity>, but I'd like to help you with that.

q026_g_5eedadbe94fd3706781b.text: As you roam the woods, <plr_identity>, remember what I've told you about the spirit of the forest.

q026_g_705857363d682d14e123.text: I suppose you're not done with the stones yet, <plr_identity>, huh?

q026_g_ac230d481db48a06e445.text: I suppose you're not done with the branches yet, <plr_identity>, huh?

q026_g_99f0495d2325b5c49051.text: It's this time of the year again, <plr_identity>. Always gets me thinking if they have been met yet. Forest maids, I mean. Met by you, by any chance?

q026_g_9905a2ba6f573cd6c09d.text: Well, <plr_identity>, there they prance in the woods, the forest maids. Hmm.

q026_g_a3847100081253e3d983.text: Well, now you know what I know about forest maids. Take care, <plr_identity>, and stay in good terms with the forest and all its beings and folk. That would be my final advise to you.

q026_g_c04f509a32665e31a097.text: Aha. So you have heard, <plr_identity>. From who?

q026_g_c26b830327538396093f.text: You have done a great deed, <plr_identity>.
